spots.name: Sakakawea Monument
spots.tip: A landmark with history. Low light brings out texture; check opening hours if it's fenced.

spots.name: Lake Campbell
spots.tip: eBird birding hotspot with 115 species recorded. Birds are most active in the first two hours after sunrise; recent sightings at ebird.org/hotspot/L7873077.

spots.name: Coffee Butte
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 638 m (2,093 ft).

spots.name: Lake Pocasse
spots.tip: A lake: calm air at dawn gives mirror reflections, and mist often sits on the water on cold mornings. The pin marks the middle of the lake: pick a shore spot facing the light.
